This figure compares approximate ranges of dormancy longevity across taxa along
with the duration of adverse environmental periods.

## Clear workspace and set plotting options

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
getwd()
setwd("~/GitHub/ClimDorm")
```

## Load packages

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(png)
library(grid)
```

## Load data

```{r}
endur <- read.csv("data/endurance_data.csv", na.strings="", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
adver <- read.csv("data/adversity_data.csv", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

# Convert recorded duration values to years for plotting.
unit_to_year <- c(
  hour=1/(24*365.25),
  day=1/365.25,
  week=7/365.25,
  month=1/12,
  year=1
)

convert_to_years <- function(value, unit) {
  conversion <- unname(unit_to_year[unit])
  if (any(!is.na(value) & is.na(conversion))) {
    stop("Unknown or missing unit for a non-missing duration value.")
  }
  value * conversion
}

endur$min_yr <- convert_to_years(endur$min_value, endur$min_unit)
endur$max_yr <- convert_to_years(endur$max_value, endur$max_unit)
adver$min_yr <- convert_to_years(adver$min_value, adver$min_unit)
adver$max_yr <- convert_to_years(adver$max_value, adver$max_unit)
```

## Define the shared time-axis and theme

```{r}
axis_breaks <- 10^seq(-6, 7, by=1)
axis_labels <- function(x) {
  parse(text=paste0("10^", round(log10(x))))
}

common <- theme_minimal(base_size=11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y=element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x=element_line(color="#e6e8eb", linewidth=.3),
    plot.title.position="panel",
    plot.title=element_text(face="bold", size=13, hjust=0.5),
    axis.title.y=element_blank(),
    axis.text.y=element_text(color="#30343b", size=9),
    plot.margin=margin(10, 18, 6, 12)
  )
```

## Dormancy endurance

```{r}
# Reverse factor order so the first row in the CSV appears at the top.
endur <- endur %>%
  mutate(taxon=factor(taxon, levels=rev(taxon)))

p1 <- ggplot(endur, aes(y=taxon)) +
  # This block creates the shaded region.
  # annotate(
  #   "rect", xmin=1, xmax=10, ymin=-Inf, ymax=Inf,
  #   fill="#dcefe8", alpha=.65
  # ) +
  geom_segment(
    data=filter(endur, !is.na(min_yr)),
    aes(x=min_yr, xend=max_yr, yend=taxon),
    linewidth=4, color="#2876d0", lineend="round"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data=filter(endur, is.na(min_yr)),
    aes(x=max_yr),
    color="#2876d0", size=2.7, shape=1, stroke=1.2
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    limits=c(1e-6, 1e7),
    breaks=axis_breaks,
    labels=axis_labels
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels=c("Daphnia ephippia" = expression(italic(Daphnia)~"ephippia"))) +
  labs(
    title="How long can dormant organisms persist?",
    x=NULL
  ) +
  common +
  theme(
    axis.text.x=element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x=element_blank()
  )

p1
```

## Duration of adverse periods

```{r adversity-plot}
adver <- adver %>%
  mutate(event=factor(event, levels=rev(event)))

p2 <- ggplot(adver, aes(y=event)) +
  # This block creates the shaded region; it is commented out.
  # annotate(
  #   "rect", xmin=1, xmax=10, ymin=-Inf, ymax=Inf,
  #   fill="#dcefe8", alpha=.65
  # ) +
  geom_segment(
    aes(x=min_yr, xend=max_yr, yend=event),
    linewidth=4, color="#ec704c", lineend="round"
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    limits=c(1e-6, 1e7),
    breaks=axis_breaks,
    labels=axis_labels
  ) +
  labs(
    title="How long do bad periods last?",
    x="Duration (years)"
  ) +
  common

p2
```

## Combine and save the figure

```{r combined-figure, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
fig <- (p1 / p2) +
  plot_layout(heights=c(1.4, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(
    # title="Clipping has a budget: endurance vs adversity on one time axis",
    # caption="Approximate ranges; open circles indicate unknown lower bounds."
  ) &
  theme(
    plot.background=element_rect(fill="white", color=NA)
  )

ggsave("figures/dorm.long.clim.pdf", fig, width=12, height=9)
ggsave("figures/dorm.long.clim.png", fig, width=12, height=9, dpi=300)

img <- readPNG("figures/dorm.long.clim.png")
grid.newpage()
grid.raster(img)
```
